how_to_apply: Online is the only valid application method; no other mode will be accepted.
Log into the BRIC-inStem website – Careers – Faculty positions (https://www.instem.res.in/facultypositions).
Fill out the online application form, with a photograph, signature and a correct, active e-mail address.
Upload a well-articulated research plan that closely aligns with the research focus of CReATE at BRIC-inStem.
Upload a cover letter articulating synergies with the research focus of inStem and indicating the position and advertisement number.
Upload the latest Caste and/or Disability Certificate from the competent authority, as applicable.
Pay the fee (if not exempted) and enter the payment reference number in the online form, before 20 November 2026.
The cover letter and research proposal should explain how the applicant's research programme will synergize with the CReATE programme. Questions about this may be sent to [email protected].

The fee is paid online through Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI, or to the bank account or through QR code/UPI ID given in the payment options document (https://www.instem.res.in/jobportal/sites/default/files/users/aoestt/Payment_options-new.pdf). Bank and transaction charges are borne by the candidate. The fee is not refunded, and an application without the fee will not be processed. SC/ST, Ex-Servicemen and PwBD candidates must upload supporting certificates.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications – without photograph and signature, with an inappropriate photograph or signature, or with an unsuccessful fee payment – will be summarily rejected. Details such as name, category, date of birth and post applied for cannot be changed after submission; category once filled will not be changed. Only one application per post: if a candidate submits several, only the last one is considered. No person is eligible who was previously dismissed or compulsorily retired from Central/State Government, PSU or autonomous institute service, or convicted for an offence involving moral turpitude. No person is eligible who has entered into a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or who, having a spouse alive, has married another person. Appointment is subject to medical fitness and verification of character, antecedents and caste, wherever applicable; canvassing is a disqualification. Disputes fall under the sole jurisdiction of courts at Bengaluru. Contact: GKVK Campus, Bellary Road, Bangalore - 560065; Phone 080-61948217; E-mail [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About BRIC-inStem
content_sections.text: The Institute for Stem Cell Science and Regenerative Medicine (BRIC-inStem), located at the GKVK Campus, Bellary Road, Bangalore, is an autonomous institute under the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council of the Department of Biotechnology. Its mandate is to establish collaborative research programmes in stem cell biology, regeneration and repair, in development and disease, with translational emphasis. The posts are at its Centre for Research, Application and Training in Embryology (CReATE), which is dedicated to fundamental and translational research in early development, using human stem cell-based models and allied approaches for applications in reproductive health, congenital anomaly prevention and regenerative medicine. The institute invites candidates in Human Embryology, Reproductive Biology, Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: BRIC-inStem has advertised 4 posts in total, filled in the scientific cadre on Direct Recruitment, failing which by Deputation (Including Short Term Contract) basis. The institute reserves the right to withdraw any or all posts, to fill or not to fill them, and to increase or decrease the number of posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. All degrees must be from a recognized Institute/University, and only post-qualification experience is counted. The cut-off date for eligibility, including age and qualifications, is the last date for receipt of online applications, including the extended date, if any. Essential qualification (Direct Recruitment): Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in any discipline of Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Chemistry/Computational Biology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Molecular Biology/Agricultural Sciences/Plant Sciences/related disciplines; or Ph.D in Engineering or Technology in disciplines like Chemical/Biomedical/Pharmaceutical engineering; or Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) in any branch of medicine/MDS/MVSc, from a recognised University or Institute or relevant areas of research. Experience: Minimum five years of post qualification experience in a responsible higher position in a research/teaching Institute/University/industry, with published research of highest standards and/or technologies of established utility. Deputation: Scientists of the Central Govt./State Govt./Universities/Public Sector Undertakings or Govt. funded research organizations/institutes who (a) possess the qualifications prescribed for direct recruits, and (b) either hold an analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre, or have 5 years' regular service in Level-12 in the relevant field. Desirable: An outstanding scientist whose research and teaching interests align with developmental and reproductive sciences, with translational potential in regenerative medicine. Ph.D or equivalent in a relevant field; postdoctoral research experience with a strong publication record. Preferred expertise: human developmental biology, reproductive endocrinology, stem cell-based disease modelling, and translational and regenerative therapies. Demonstrated ability to secure competitive research funding. Expertise in techniques such as CRISPR, organoid culture, single-cell omics, bioengineering and computational approaches. Essential qualification (Direct Recruitment): Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in any discipline of Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Chemistry/Computational Biology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Molecular Biology/Agricultural Sciences/Plant Sciences/related disciplines; or Ph.D in Engineering or Technology in disciplines like Chemical/Biomedical/Pharmaceutical engineering; or Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) in any branch of medicine/MDS/MVSc, from a recognised University or Institute or relevant areas of research. Experience: Minimum three years of post-qualification experience in a responsible higher position in a research/teaching Institute/University/industry, with published research of highest standards and/or technologies of established utility. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Scientist-E carries Pay Level 13 and Scientist-D carries Pay Level 12 in the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (Entry Level). Other benefits named in the notice are Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (in lieu of accommodation), Transport Allowance, Children Education Allowance, Leave Travel Concession and Medical Facilities, as applicable to the institute from time to time. The selected candidate will be covered under the National Pension System (NPS). There is a probation period of 2 years for the posts. The notice states that generous start-up support is provided, and extramural funding is encouraged. Selected candidates may be posted and transferred anywhere in India as per the requirement of the institute.

content_sections.heading: BRIC-inStem Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice gives one set of expectations for all faculty posts (Scientist-E and Scientist-D): Undertake high-quality research and contribute to the mandate of the institute. Mentor Ph.D. students and postdoctoral fellows. Contribute to the teaching and outreach activities of BRIC-inStem.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility does not entitle a candidate to be called for assessment. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a seminar, interaction and an interview. The institute reserves the right to determine the mode of screening and evaluation for shortlisting and selection. Candidates shortlisted for interview must produce original documents for verification of reservation category, educational qualification, experience and other claims. Candidates employed in Government/PSUs/State Government/Autonomous Organizations, and Departmental Candidates, must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer at the time of interview, failing which they will not be allowed to appear in the interview. Interview schedules, notices and results will be posted only on the official website of inStem ( https://www.instem.res.in ); all correspondence is by e-mail only.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BRIC-inStem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: Scientist-E for OBC(NCL) and ST (one each), and Scientist-D for UR and ST (one each).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BRIC-inStem Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the online application is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for BRIC-inStem Scientist-E and Scientist-D?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in Life Sciences or related disciplines, a Ph.D in Engineering or Technology, or an M.D./MDS/MVSc, with minimum five years (Scientist-E) or three years (Scientist-D) of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BRIC-inStem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Direct Recruitment, Scientist-E is not exceeding 45+3 years (OBC(NCL)) or 45+5 years (ST), and Scientist-D is not exceeding 40 years (UR) or 40+5 years (ST); for Deputation it is 56 years for all posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for BRIC-inStem Scientist posts?
faq.answer: Scientist-E carries Pay Level 13 and Scientist-D Pay Level 12 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, with DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Children Education Allowance, LTC and medical facilities.
